content.lead: After this unit you will be able to:
items: say where you want to go and for how long (nach Italien, in die Berge, ans Meer);
ask about and describe the weather;
compare places and things (wärmer, billiger, am schönsten);
book a room and ask about the price and the dates;
make suggestions and say what you would like (Wie wäre es mit …?, Ich möchte …).
